verdict.rationale: Drata's API v2 reference lives under an /openapi/reference/v2/ path covering many resource tags (Personnel, Devices, Controls, Policies, Risks, Audits). That implies the docs are generated from an OpenAPI spec. However, no evidence shows a downloadable spec file, and probes of standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI/JSON/YAML spec URL, confirmation that the spec can be fetched programmatically, and hands-on verification of the download.
